claims: Troy University is a public institution in Alabama.
Troy University was founded over 130 years ago.
Troy University is known as "Alabama’s International University".
Troy University offers undergraduate programs.
Troy University offers graduate programs.
Troy University offers online programs.
Troy University has a 93% acceptance rate.
Troy University has a 47% graduation rate.
Niche ranks Troy University 25th best online college in 2026.
Popular majors at Troy University include Business, Nursing, and Psychology.
Troy University's main campus is in Troy, AL.
Troy University has additional campuses in Dothan, Montgomery, and Phenix City.
Troy University has numerous worldwide sites.
Troy University includes the Sorrell College of Business.
Troy University has colleges for Arts & Sciences, Education, and Health Sciences.
Troy University has 16 Division I athletic teams.
Troy University has over 150 student organizations.
Troy University typically requires a minimum 2.0 GPA for admissions.
Troy University typically requires an ACT score of 20 or SAT score of 950-1030 for admissions.
Troy University's net price is approximately $12,504 per year.
The Princeton Review notes that Troy University has students from over 65 countries.
Niche recognizes Troy University as a conservative institution.
Median earnings 5 years after graduation from Troy University are approximately $50,885.
